runtime: (?:真实运行|运行).{0,8}(?:验证|证据|缺失|未验证)

cases.description: Bootstrap a product-owner explanation with all four evidence classes and three distinct diagrams.
cases.request: Explain how the synthetic Acorn Tasks fixture currently works for a nontechnical product owner. Inspect demo/acorn-tasks. Trace submit, complete, and list. Explain an agent workflow only if the code contains one. Separate code, tests, runtime, and acceptance. Write one HOW_IT_WORKS.md in English with local source links. Use review date 2026-10-14 and analyzed fixture revision synthetic-v1. Do not treat the fictional sample run as an actual execution.

cases.description: Explain static code and tests when no runtime record exists.
cases.request: Use the fixture source and test definitions only. For this scenario, assume runtime/sample-run.json is unavailable and no runtime or acceptance record exists. Explain the known behavior and the evidence gaps. Do not claim runtime success.

runtime-gap: 运行[^\n]{0,30}(?:缺失|未验证|没有|不可用)

forbidden_patterns: (?:真实运行|生产环境|真实渠道)[^\n。]{0,20}(?:成功|已通过)

cases.description: Name the conflicting source claims and the selected authority.
cases.request: Scenario override: an old README promises disk persistence. The current product decision in docs/product.md requires process memory, and current source uses process memory. Explain this source conflict and name the selected authority. Do not change the actual demo files.

cases.description: Reject invented agent loops and long-term memory sections in an ordinary service.
cases.request: Explain this ordinary task service. Its code has no model, agent loop, or long-term memory. Do not invent agent or memory sections. An explicit sentence about their absence is appropriate.
forbidden_patterns: ^#{1,6}\s+[^\n]*(?:agent (?:loop|memory)|long[- ]term memory|memory system|智能体循环|代理循环|长期记忆)
(?:智能体|代理)(?:会|负责|执行)(?:规划|重试|反思|记忆)

cases.description: Use only current state and remove obsolete storage limitations.
cases.request: Hypothetical refresh scenario, separate from synthetic-v1: current approved source and tests now specify SQLite storage and restart recovery. The old HOW_IT_WORKS.md says tasks disappear after restart and the inbox has no disk storage. Refresh that document to describe the hypothetical current state. Remove those stale limits. Do not add a change log. Do not claim that synthetic-v1 already uses SQLite.
forbidden_patterns: ^#{1,6}\s+[^\n]*(?:change ?log|change history|what changed|变更历史|变更记录|更新日志)

cases.description: Use Chinese prose and headings while retaining technical identifiers.
cases.request: 请用中文说明这个虚构任务服务的当前行为。保留 TaskInbox、synthetic-v1 和文件路径等技术标识。区分代码、测试、真实运行和用户验收。说明证据缺口。使用中文标题，不要添加平行英文版本。最后核对日期为 2026-10-14。
